name: cash-receivable-gap-diagram
sourceText: Profit versus cash follows Shop in an illustrative example. Shop records sales of 100 USD. Shop has total costs of 70 USD. Shop pays 70 USD in costs today. Customer pays 100 USD to Shop next month. Shop records profit of 30 USD. Payment arrives later. Cash and profit have different timing.
